props.atom: /obj/ViltrumConsole{name = "Imperial directory"; status_text = "Audience hall and offices. South: forum and spaceport. West: residences. East: research enclave. Both outer terraces bypass the hall."}
/obj/ViltrumConsole{name = "Terrace services"; status_text = "Communal residences north; clinic and dining south. Palace east; civic market south. Public rooms use open arches."}
/obj/ViltrumConsole{name = "Research records"; status_text = "Civil research, medical observation and the scientific archive. Medical laboratory east, archive south. Energy works southeast."}
/obj/ViltrumConsole{name = "Training course"; status_text = "Central field: fifty tiles square. The outer loop remains clear for endurance running. Forum east; badlands south."}
/obj/ViltrumConsole{name = "Civic exchange"; status_text = "Civic exchange and public meeting halls. Equipment gallery west, communal food hall east. Forum east; residential terraces north."}
/obj/ViltrumConsole{name = "War college directory"; status_text = "Arena south: four open exits and a 48 by 48 clear combat floor. Spectator circulation runs around the perimeter. Barracks east."}

/obj/ViltrumConsole{name = "Planetary grid diagnostics"; status_text = "Generator service court north. Research northwest; fabrication southwest. Grid diagnostics nominal. Keep generator approaches clear."}

/obj/ViltrumConsole{name = "Freight dispatch"; status_text = "Clear freight apron east. Imperial terminal is east along either perimeter route. Maintenance south. Hangars are public staging interiors."}
/obj/ViltrumConsole{name = "Fabrication orders"; status_text = "Precision hall west; repairs east; freight warehouse south. Open service court connects the spaceport and energy works."}
/obj/ViltrumConsole{name = "Polar survey record"; status_text = "Ancient strata exposed beneath the escarpment. Survey chamber open. Citadel east; beacon west."}
/obj/ViltrumConsole{name = "Defense command directory"; status_text = "Twin defense wings face the parade court. Palace south; polar survey west; preserve east."}

/obj/ViltrumConsole{name = "Aqueduct pressure station"; status_text = "Reservoir channel runs north-south. Use the southern and northern crossings. Residential terraces east; training grounds south."}
/obj/ViltrumConsole{name = "Cliff service records"; status_text = "Eastern maintenance passage. Science enclave west; energy works south. Cliff terrace loop open."}

/obj/ViltrumConsole{name = "Recovered research log"; status_text = "Archive fragment: the eastern array was evacuated before the last polar storm. Two laboratory wings remain accessible around the open court."}
/obj/ViltrumConsole{name = "Southern relay"; status_text = "Polar relay synchronized. Follow the coast west to the landing apron, or north toward fabrication."}

/obj/EarthDirectory{directions_text = "Welcome to the western city. Hospital south; residential streets north; civic center southeast. The open lawn east is reserved for planetary arrivals."; name = "Arrival park routes"}
/obj/EarthDirectory{directions_text = "Public wards north and south. Reception is through the open central corridor. Arrival park north; pharmacy across the road."; name = "Hospital directory"}
/obj/EarthDirectory{directions_text = "Town hall and civic square. Hospital northwest; shops south; garage southwest. River crossings connect both banks."; name = "Civic district routes"}
